title: Gugure! Kokkuri-san Specials
justification: AniList: 11 shorts of 4 min, 2014-12-24 to 2015-05-27. AniDB 10530 S1-S11 ("OVA 1-11") are eleven specials on those dates in pairs (12-24 x2, 01-28 x2, 02-25 x2, 03-25 x2, 04-24 x2, 05-27); S12+ are undated extras and not in the run. TVDB 283933 season 0 0x1-0x11 "Special Short Episode #1-#11", same dates, and titles agree one by one: #1 Bell of Friendship = S1 Kokkuri-san to Nakayoshi no Suzu!; #2 His Tail Came Off = S2 Shippotoreta?; #3 Technophobia = S3 Digital Kowai Kokkuri-san!; #4 Kohina's Secrets = S4 Himitsu no Kohina-chan!; #5 Inugami-san Transferred In = S5 Inushin-san ga Ten'nyuu Suru Asa!; #6 Valentine's = S6 Valentine no Kokkuri-san?; #7 Wonderland = S7 Fushigi no Kuni no Kokkuri-san?; #8 Mafia with No Moral Code = S8 Jingi Naki Mafia?; #9 Ichimatsu House = S9 Dokidoki? Ichimatsu-ka?; #10 Momotaro's Companions = S10 Momotarou no Otomotte?; #11 A Day Without Kokkuri-san = S11 Kokkuri-san no Inai Hi?. Parent has no mapping list: S<n> defaults to 0x<n>.
